zh: 上个月我们终于还清了车贷。
en: We finally {paid off|repaid|cleared|paid back} the car loan last month.

zh: 我正在攒钱付房子的首付。
en: I'm {saving up for|saving for} a house deposit.

zh: 他借的钱到现在还没还。
en: He still hasn't {paid back|repaid|returned|given back} the money he borrowed.

zh: 现在只有一份收入，我们得缩减开支。
en: We need to {cut back|cut down|save|budget|economise|economize} now that we're on one income.

zh: 他们办了房贷买了第一套房子。
en: They {took out|got} a mortgage to buy their first home.

zh: 她每次发工资都留出一百块以备急用。
en: She {sets aside|puts aside|puts away|saves|keeps} a hundred dollars every payday for emergencies.

zh: 今年房租又涨了。
en: Rent has {gone up|increased|risen} again this year.

zh: 油价终于降了一点。
en: Petrol prices have finally {come down|gone down|dropped|fallen|eased} a bit.

zh: 圣诞节期间他刷出了一大笔信用卡账单。
en: He {ran up|racked up|built up|got} a huge credit card bill over Christmas.

zh: 在奥克兰靠一份收入很难过日子。
en: It's hard to {get by|live|survive|manage|cope} on one income in Auckland.

zh: 我们被那个出租车司机宰了。
en: We got {ripped off|overcharged|cheated|scammed|robbed} by that taxi driver.

zh: 我不得不掏八百块钱换新轮胎。
en: I had to {fork out|shell out|pay|cough up|spend|find} eight hundred dollars for new tyres.

zh: 我的雇主每个月都往我的KiwiSaver里存钱。
en: My employer {pays into|contributes to} my KiwiSaver every month.

zh: 我在算我欠多少税。
en: I'm trying to {work out|figure out|calculate|find out|see|check} how much tax I owe.

zh: 坐公交之前我得给我的Hop卡充值。
en: I need to {top up|load|recharge|reload|put money on} my Hop card before I catch the bus.

zh: 我们不得不动用积蓄来修屋顶。
en: We had to {dip into|use|spend|break into|draw on|tap into} our savings to fix the roof.

zh: 房东把房租每周涨了五十块。
en: The landlord has {put up|raised|increased|lifted|bumped up|pushed up|hiked} the rent by fifty dollars a week.

zh: 保险公司一周之内就赔付了。
en: The insurance company {paid out|paid up|paid|settled} within a week.

zh: 这个副业每个月能带来大约五百块的收入。
en: The side business {brings in|makes|earns|generates|pulls in} about five hundred dollars a month.

zh: 我需要查一下机票多少钱。
en: I need to {find out|check|see|know|work out|figure out|look up} how much the flight costs.

zh: 假期过后价格应该会趋于平稳。
en: Prices should {even out|level out|settle down|settle|stabilise|stabilize} after the holidays.

zh: 油价已经降了。
en: Petrol prices have {gone down|come down|dropped|fallen}.

zh: 我得去ATM取点现金。
en: I need to {take out|get out|withdraw|get} some cash from the ATM.

zh: 她偷偷存了一点钱以防万一。
en: She has some money {tucked away|put away|saved|stashed away} for emergencies.

zh: 我在攒钱买一辆新车。
en: I'm {saving up for|saving for} a new car.

zh: 他加入KiwiSaver几个月后又选择退出了。
en: He {opted out} of KiwiSaver after a few months.

zh: 我们每人出二十块给她买个礼物吧。
en: Let's all {kick in|chip in|pitch in|put in} twenty dollars for her present.

zh: 他们出国旅游刷了一大笔信用卡账单。
en: They {ran up|racked up|built up} a huge credit card bill on their trip overseas.

zh: 那家咖啡馆周末赚得盆满钵满。
en: That café is {raking in|bringing in|pulling in|making|earning} a fortune at the weekends.

zh: 奶奶给了我五十块，让我攒着买新自行车。
en: Grandma gave me fifty dollars to {put towards|put toward|spend on} a new bike.

zh: 这家公司被一家澳大利亚银行收购了。
en: The company was {taken over|bought|bought out|acquired} by an Australian bank.

zh: 这家咖啡馆在封城期间倒闭了。
en: The café {went under|went bust|closed|closed down|folded} during lockdown.

zh: 他的信用卡已经刷爆了。
en: He's {maxed out} his credit card.

zh: 如果你不交费，他们会停你的电。
en: They'll {cut off|disconnect|turn off|shut off} the power if you don't pay.

zh: 今天早上我去银行把现金存了进去。
en: I {paid in|deposited|banked} the cash at the bank this morning.

zh: 我们靠一份工资勉强度日。
en: We're just {scraping by|getting by|managing|surviving|making do} on one income.

zh: 我们终于还清了房贷。
en: We've finally {paid off|paid back|cleared|repaid} the mortgage.

zh: 他欠我五十块，就是不肯还。
en: He owes me fifty bucks, but he won't {pay up|pay}.

zh: 他得醒醒了，别再借钱给朋友了。
en: He needs to {wise up} and stop lending money to his mates.

zh: 房租吃掉了我一半的工资。
en: Rent {eats up|takes up|uses up|swallows up} half my pay.

zh: 我们把账单凑个整，算一百块吧。
en: Let's {round up} the bill to a hundred dollars and call it even.

zh: 在奥克兰，靠最低工资很难生活。
en: It's hard to {live on|live off|survive on|get by on} the minimum wage in Auckland.

zh: 他的信用卡已经欠了五千块。
en: He's {racked up|run up|built up|accumulated} five thousand dollars on his credit card.

zh: 买第一套房的时候可以把养老金取出来。
en: You can {cash out|withdraw|take out} your KiwiSaver when you buy your first home.

zh: 买保险之前最好货比三家。
en: It's worth {shopping around|comparing prices} before you buy insurance.

zh: 她数出了二十块钱的硬币。
en: She {counted out|counted} twenty dollars in coins.

zh: 我们还是等明年再买车吧。
en: Let's {hold off|put off} buying a car until next year.

zh: 这个项目我们超预算了。
en: We {went over} budget on this project.

zh: 过生日我奢侈了一把，买了块新手表。
en: I {splashed out on|splurged on|treated myself to|spent big on} a new watch for my birthday.

zh: 货比三家可以降低你的电费。
en: Shopping around can {bring down|lower|reduce|cut} your power bill.

zh: 我下周把钱还给你。
en: I'll {pay back|repay|return} the money next week.

zh: 我失业以后拖欠了房租。
en: I {fell behind|got behind} with the rent after I lost my job.

zh: 为了付房子首付，他们已经存了一点钱。
en: They've {put by|put aside|set aside|put away|saved up|saved} a bit of money for a house deposit.

zh: 圣诞节后销量慢慢下滑了。
en: Sales {tailed off|dropped off|fell off|slowed down|dropped|declined} after Christmas.

zh: 你能把费用给我分项列一下吗？
en: Can you {break down|itemise|itemize|split up} the costs for me?

zh: 我把股票兑现了来支付婚礼费用。
en: I {cashed in|sold|cashed out} my shares to pay for the wedding.

zh: 我想趁利率还低把它锁定。
en: I want to {lock in|fix|secure} a low interest rate before rates go up.

zh: 那些早早卖掉房子的人吃亏了。
en: People who sold their houses too early {lost out|missed out}.

zh: 有点积蓄以防万一是好事。
en: It's good to have some savings to {fall back on|rely on}.

zh: 我们算一下账吧，上次的油钱我还欠你。
en: Let's {settle up|square up}. I still owe you for petrol.

zh: 夏天以来销量已经回升了。
en: Sales have {bounced back|recovered|picked up|rebounded} since the summer.

zh: 我在银行填了三张表格。
en: I {filled out|filled in|completed} three forms at the bank.
